title: Quran Vision Corpus (Kur'ân Vizyonu Külliyatı) v6.2.1: Bilingual 26-Step Strategic Tafsir, Maqasid & Civilization Foresight Corpus (14 Foundational Reports)

creators.name: Yarıcı, Mehmet
creators.affiliation: Quran Vision Institute / Kur'ân Vizyonu Stratejik Tefsir Külliyatı

description: Quran Vision Corpus (v6.2.1) is an open-access bilingual (Turkish / English) academic corpus and interactive foresight cockpit featuring 14 foundational Quranic verse reports (QV-2026-001 to QV-2026-014). Every monograph integrates 71 primary classical Arabic tafsir citations (ISNAD 2nd Edition verified) with 42 contemporary empirical datasets (APA 7 / DOI: World Bank, UNDP, WJP, UNESCO, SIPRI, OECD), 10-year Bayesian policy simulations (2026–2036), falsifiable early-warning thresholds, and 40-minute competency-based seminar/classroom debate lesson plans.
